universityIndex.title: Building African leadership
universityIndex.intro1: The Digital University of Morocco (UNM) is a higher-education institution dedicated to executive education, with a vocation resolutely turned toward Africa and its dynamics of transformation.
universityIndex.intro2: Through an academic offering structured around executive education, UNM supports executives, leaders and future leaders in developing the strategic, managerial and decision-making skills required by African realities.
universityIndex.intro3: Positioned at the intersection of academic excellence and operational stakes, UNM favours an action-oriented approach, integrating African case studies, field experience and international openness.
universityIndex.missionBody: Contribute actively to the emergence of an innovative, responsible African leadership able to take on the continent's economic, social and technological challenges.
universityIndex.accreditationsSubtitle: These accreditations apply to European Business School, UNM's academic partner — not to the Digital University of Morocco as an institution.

ebs.title: European Business School & Digital University of Morocco
ebs.tagline: Training the leaders who drive Africa’s transformations
ebs.ebsAbout: Since its founding in 1967, EBS Paris has been regarded as a revolutionary school. EBS is a Parisian grande école of management with a European footprint (Paris, Dublin, Barcelona).
ebs.intro1: Because the continent’s economic, institutional and managerial challenges call for high-level skills, European Business School (EBS Paris) and the Digital University of Morocco (UNM) have joined forces to build an Executive education offering designed for African executives, leaders, entrepreneurs and decision-makers.
ebs.intro2: This alliance rests on a strong conviction: the sustainable development of African organisations depends on quality education, connected to international standards while deeply rooted in the continent’s realities.
ebs.intro3: Programmes developed jointly by EBS Paris and UNM combine academic excellence, professional experience and an action-oriented approach to support the transformation of African companies, public institutions and organisations.
ebs.allianceTitle: An alliance for skills development in Africa
ebs.allianceLead: The partnership between EBS and the Digital University of Morocco shares a common vision of Executive Education: training leaders able to meet the economic, social and institutional challenges of a continent in transformation.
ebs.principlesLabel: Our approach is built on several core principles:
ebs.principle1: A pedagogy adapted to the constraints of working professionals
ebs.principle2: Teaching grounded in international best practices
ebs.principle4: A permanent link between strategic thinking and operational application
ebs.why1Body: EBS academic excellence is combined with UNM’s deep knowledge of African economic and managerial realities.
ebs.why2Body: Programmes are designed so participants can continue their professional activity while building skills that are immediately usable in their organisation.
ebs.why3Body: Each programme prioritises real situations, case studies, experience sharing and applied projects to create concrete impact on professional practice.
ebs.why4Body: Participants join a network of leaders, executives and entrepreneurs from many African countries, fostering experience sharing, partnerships and professional opportunities.
ebs.photoAlt: EBS Paris campus and student life
ebs.description: Training the leaders who drive Africa’s transformations
ebs.descriptionExtra: EBS Paris and UNM combine their expertise for Executive education connected to international standards and rooted in African realities.
ebs.pillar1Body: EBS academic excellence × UNM insight into African realities.
ebs.pillar2Body: Programmes built for professionals who keep working while they learn.
ebs.pillar3Body: Real cases, applied projects and a pan-African community of leaders.
ebs.externalLinksLead: Two official pages on ebs-paris.fr — click to open.

contact.faq1Q: How quickly will I get a reply?
contact.faq1A: We reply to messages within 48 business hours. Callback requests are handled within 24 hours in your chosen slot.
contact.faq2Q: Can I apply from this page?
contact.faq2A: For an application, use the Admissions page. Contact is for questions, guidance and partnerships.
contact.faq3A: Two intakes per year. Applications are open on a rolling basis; places are awarded after file review and interview.
contact.faq4A: Bachelor’s for MBAs and Executive certificates · Master’s for the DBA. Professional experience is recommended.
contact.faq5A: Yes. Formats (on-campus, online, hybrid) are designed for working executives.
contact.faq6A: The main campus is in Marrakech (Borj Menara I). The team can also guide you toward Laâyoune depending on the programme.
